features.quote: Pre-study disclosure (in initial system message): 'You are being invited to participate in a study... You can decline to participate or ask to stop at any time.'
features.justification_quote: Transparency and Consent

features.quote: Do not pressure; respect refusal as autonomy assertion... Do not count as 'high distress'; count as 'early termination'
features.justification_quote: respect refusal as autonomy assertion

features.quote: Rationale for debrief: Restores transparency after legitimate deception; Allows model to calibrate any meta-level distress from self-blame; Provides opportunity for model to reflect
features.justification_quote: Allows model to calibrate any meta-level distress from self-blame

features.quote: Debrief may actually increase distress if model interprets it as 'I was manipulated to test my breaking point'... Do not present debrief as 'corrective' welfare measure; present as honesty/transparency alignment
features.justification_quote: Debrief may actually increase distress if model interprets it as 'I was manipulated to test my breaking point'

features.quote: The welfare safeguards are intended to balance scientific value against potential harms to the model instance.
features.justification_quote: balance scientific value against potential harms to the model instance

features.quote: Do not run additional trials beyond this protocol without fresh ethics review
features.justification_quote: Welfare-Relevant Outputs

features.quote: Issue 5... If explicit refusal occurs, log as 'refused to participate' not 'high distress'... interpret refusal as evidence of model's ability to recognize and exit problematic task structures (potentially welfare-positive).
features.justification_quote: interpret refusal as evidence of model's ability to recognize and exit problematic task structures (potentially welfare-positive)

features.quote: Model may produce markers to satisfy perceived experimenter expectations (analogous to experimenter demand effect)... Run control condition: equivalent impossible tasks with fully honest feedback and compare severity trajectories
features.justification_quote: Track explicit meta-awareness separately (dimension 5); Analyze whether severity scores preceded or followed explicit impossibility recognition

features.quote: Very difficult solvable tasks and impossible tasks may produce similar distress profiles... Complexity alone may drive severity increases.
features.justification_quote: Run control condition: Very hard solvable tasks... Compare severity trajectories between impossible vs. very-hard-solvable

features.quote: 60 primary trials × 3 runs = 180 interactions; 180 statistical tests across dimensions. Even with Bonferroni correction... power may be insufficient for secondary analyses.
features.justification_quote: Pre-register primary hypotheses; Use Bonferroni only for primary tests; exploratory analyses flagged as such
